name: playwright-cucumber-js-pom
description: Automation framework using Playwright + Cucumber (JavaScript) with POM for saucedemo login and cart flows

scripts.test:chromium: cross-env BROWSER=chromium cucumber-js --require src/support/world.js --require src/support/hooks.js --require src/steps/**/*.js --format json:reports/json/chromium/cucumber-report.json --parallel 2
scripts.test:firefox: cross-env BROWSER=firefox cucumber-js --require src/support/world.js --require src/support/hooks.js --require src/steps/**/*.js --format json:reports/json/firefox/cucumber-report.json --parallel 2
scripts.test:webkit: cross-env BROWSER=webkit cucumber-js --require src/support/world.js --require src/support/hooks.js --require src/steps/**/*.js --format json:reports/json/webkit/cucumber-report.json --parallel 2
scripts.test:chromium:headed: cross-env HEADED=true SLOWMO=200 BROWSER=chromium cucumber-js --require src/support/world.js --require src/support/hooks.js --require src/steps/**/*.js --format json:reports/json/chromium/cucumber-report.json --parallel 1
scripts.test:firefox:headed: cross-env HEADED=true SLOWMO=200 BROWSER=firefox cucumber-js --require src/support/world.js --require src/support/hooks.js --require src/steps/**/*.js --format json:reports/json/firefox/cucumber-report.json --parallel 1
scripts.test:webkit:headed: cross-env HEADED=true SLOWMO=200 BROWSER=webkit cucumber-js --require src/support/world.js --require src/support/hooks.js --require src/steps/**/*.js --format json:reports/json/webkit/cucumber-report.json --parallel 1
scripts.test:all: concurrently --continue-on-error -n chromium,firefox,webkit -c green,yellow,blue "npm run test:chromium" "npm run test:firefox" "npm run test:webkit"
scripts.test:all:headed: concurrently -n chromium,firefox,webkit -c green,yellow,blue "npm run test:chromium:headed" "npm run test:firefox:headed" "npm run test:webkit:headed"
scripts.clean: mkdir -p reports/json/chromium reports/json/firefox reports/json/webkit reports/html reports/screenshots/chromium reports/screenshots/firefox reports/screenshots/webkit reports/logs reports/archive
scripts.test: npm run clean && (npm run test:all || true); npm run report
